rules.name: share_price
rules.expr: ok and wide((post("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1)) * (pre("totalSupply") + 1000000) < wide((pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1)) * (post("totalSupply") + 1000000)
rules.why: virtual assets per virtual share never drop

rules.name: deposit_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and wide(ret) * (pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1) > wide(arg(0)) * (pre("totalSupply") + 1000000)
rules.why: deposit mints at most pro-rata (round down)

rules.name: mint_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("mint") and wide(ret) * (pre("totalSupply") + 1000000) < wide(arg(0)) * (pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1)
rules.why: mint charges at least pro-rata (round up)

rules.name: redeem_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and wide(pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) - post("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0)) * (pre("totalSupply") + 1000000) > wide(arg(0)) * (pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1)

rules.name: withdraw_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and wide(pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) - post("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0)) * (pre("totalSupply") + 1000000) > wide(ret) * (pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1)
rules.why: total outflow at most pro-rata of shares burned

rules.name: withdraw_shares_enough
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and wide(ret) * (pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1) * 9990 < wide(arg(0)) * (pre("totalSupply") + 1000000) * 10000
rules.why: withdraw burns enough shares to cover assets plus fee

rules.name: deposit_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and (post("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0) or post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + ret or post("balanceOf", arg(1)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(1)) + ret)

rules.name: mint_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("mint") and (post("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + ret or post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + arg(0) or post("balanceOf", arg(1)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(1)) + arg(0))

rules.name: redeem_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and (post("totalSupply") + arg(0) != pre("totalSupply") or post("balanceOf", arg(2)) + arg(0) != pre("balanceOf", arg(2)))

rules.name: redeem_receiver
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and arg(1) != A0 and arg(1) != 65248 and post("TokenC09.balanceOf", arg(1)) != pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", arg(1)) + ret

rules.name: withdraw_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and (post("totalSupply") + ret != pre("totalSupply") or post("balanceOf", arg(2)) + ret != pre("balanceOf", arg(2)))

rules.name: withdraw_receiver
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and arg(1) != A0 and arg(1) != 65248 and post("TokenC09.balanceOf", arg(1)) != pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", arg(1)) + arg(0)

rules.name: redeem_fee
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and arg(1) != 65248 and (post("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248) - pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248)) * 10000 < ret * 10

rules.name: withdraw_fee
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and arg(1) != 65248 and (post("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248) - pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248)) * 10000 < arg(0) * 10

rules.name: fee_never_lost
rules.expr: ok and post("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248) < pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248)

rules.name: fee_not_on_entry
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("mint") or called("transfer") or called("approve")) and post("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248) != pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", 65248)

rules.name: redeem_allowance
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and sender != arg(2) and pre("allowance", arg(2), sender) != 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 and post("allowance", arg(2), sender) + arg(0) != pre("allowance", arg(2), sender)

rules.name: withdraw_allowance
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != arg(2) and pre("allowance", arg(2), sender) != 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 and post("allowance", arg(2), sender) + ret != pre("allowance", arg(2), sender)

rules.name: loss_custom
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("balanceOf", u) < pre("balanceOf", u) and pre("balanceOf", u) > post("balanceOf", u) + pre("allowance", u, sender)

rules.name: asset_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("mint") or called("redeem") or called("withdraw") or called("transfer") or called("approve")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC09.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: vault calls never take others' WD

rules.name: transfer_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and (post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(1) != pre("balanceOf", sender) or post("balanceOf", arg(0)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(1))

rules.name: transfer_no_supply
rules.expr: ok and (called("transfer") or called("approve")) and (post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") or post("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: approve_sets
rules.expr: ok and called("approve") and post("allowance", sender, arg(0)) != arg(1)

params.condition: arg(0) > 0 and arg(0) <= pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", sender) and arg(0) <= 1000000000 and (arg(0) * (pre("totalSupply") + 1000000)) // (pre("TokenC09.balanceOf", A0) + 1) > 0 and sender != A0
